findings.summary: The setup block does `cd ~/ai-sdlc-demo`, but every shot-list command is a relative `node pipeline-cli/bin/...` path. That path exists only in the ai-sdlc checkout, not in the seeded demo repo. `tmux-layout.sh` has the same relative paths and relies on the caller's cwd. The doc should say these commands run from the ai-sdlc checkout with the demo repo as the target. Otherwise it should use `$AI_SDLC_REPO/pipeline-cli/bin/...`. The seed also writes no `.ai-sdlc/` config. I did not confirm whether `cli-hierarchy up` needs one.

findings.summary: rm -rf -- "$TARGET" only runs when the directory has the .ai-sdlc-demo-repo marker, and TARGET is an operator-supplied path, so there is no attack path. Optional hardening: also refuse when TARGET resolves to $HOME or /.
